periods.time: Seven Stars final and award ceremony
periods.label: 决赛赛评与营运委员长
titles: 七星剑武祭营运委员长

status.current: explains the final and presents awards

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Champion whose impossible return Kaieda cannot explain by normal magic theory.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Runner-up whose attacks and heat limits he analyzes.

periods.summary: Kaieda serves as expert commentator for the final, explaining the competitors' tactics, the risk of the match, Stella's heat techniques, and Ikki's chances after being blasted out of the ring. When Ikki returns with increased magic, Kaieda admits it contradicts ordinary magical knowledge. The next day he leads the award ceremony, presents Stella's runner-up certificate and Ikki's championship certificate/title, and is about to close the festival when Kagami interrupts.

key_events.summary: Introduces the final as official commentator and explains the dangerous stakes.
Recognizes that Ikki's magic increase defies standard theory.
Awards Stella and Ikki their placements and title.

periods.time: Kyushu refugee command after Kurono's recall
periods.label: 九州残留骑士的指挥官
titles: 七星剑武祭执行委员长

status.current: remains in Kyushu to coordinate post-Daien response and possible Tokyo reinforcements

relationships.toka-todo: Supports her grid operation, presents it to Itsuki, and gives final permission to begin extreme power transmission.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Reports directly to him and seeks authorization for the risky Kyushu plan.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Receives Kyushu coordination after Kurono is recalled to Tokyo.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Works alongside her in refugee control and civilian protection.

periods.summary: Kaieda attends the Daien strategy meeting as a prominent B-rank-or-higher knight, then remains in Kyushu after Kurono is ordered back to Tokyo. He tries to keep order among the refugees, promising protection despite public anger. When Toka proposes the power-grid strategy, Kaieda supports her rather than suppressing the plan, helps present it to Itsuki Kurogane, and coordinates the operational authorization. At Central Substation, he receives repair status from the electrical teams, confirms that all people have completed their work, and orders extreme operation when Toka is ready. He recognizes that Toka's capacity to accept others' entrusted power exceeds his own.

key_events.summary: Participates in the elite Daien討伐 meeting and asks about Excessive Awakening.
Backs Toka's plan before Itsuki and supervises the Central Substation execution.
Orders the grid's extreme operation and sees Toka receive the entrusted electricity.

periods.time: Tokyo Bay defensive line against PSYON
periods.label: 审判天雷迎战超人复制军

status.current: defeated and badly injured by massed Abraham clones but survives after Kurono's intervention
status.condition: limbs twisted and knocked out during the front-line collapse

relationships.yuri-oreki: Saves her from an Abraham clone's point-blank attack.
relationships.abraham-carter: Able to kill individual clones with lightning speed, but overwhelmed by their numbers.

periods.summary: Kaieda appears on the Tokyo Bay front as one of the few Japanese knights fast and strong enough to counter individual Abraham clones. His crimson lightning spear chars one clone and saves Oreki, and he warns that only fighters who move faster than the clones can fight them directly. However, PSYON's numbers eventually catch him with psychokinesis, twist his limbs and hurl him away, contributing to the front's collapse before Kurono's awakening reverses the situation.

key_events.summary: Kills Abraham clones with lightning speed but is overwhelmed by massed PSYON.
